ops.title: Per-upgrade macOS TCC re-prompt FIXED in cc-pool v0.59.0 + cookiesync v0.16.0 via bundle+embedded-profile — never again tell the user to \"approve once per upgrade\"
ops.body:
The per-upgrade macOS consent re-prompt (the one the user demanded fixed "once and for all") is RESOLVED as of **cc-pool v0.59.0** (tag bd55a87b) and **cookiesync v0.16.0**. Do NOT ever again advise "approve the group-container prompt once per Mac after the cask upgrade" — that guidance was the symptom, not a fix.

**Root cause**: a bare Mach-O at a versioned Homebrew path is a path-keyed TCC client (client_type=1) that re-mints every release; and macOS fallback consent for an unauthorized app-group claim is INSTANCE-scoped, so no TCC-row-keying trick (v0.45.0 dotted identifier, v0.49.1 stable-path re-exec) could ever make it durable. Both prior "fixes" are deleted.

**The fix** (Apple's documented no-prompt contract): ship the daemon as a real bundle **CCPoolDaemon.app** (CFBundleIdentifier `com.yasyf.cc-pool.daemon`) with an **embedded Developer ID provisioning profile** authorizing the app group, resolve the container via `containerURLForSecurityApplicationGroupIdentifier:` (fusekit `appgroup` pkg, purego, CGO_ENABLED=0) — never a raw path join. tccd then keys the grant to the bundle IDENTIFIER (client_type=0), durable across upgrades. The portal mints the team wildcard `SXKCTF23Q2.*`, which authorizes `SXKCTF23Q2.ccp`. cookiesync gets the same via CookieSync.app (`com.github.yasyf.cookiesync`) for its AppBundles/Automation grants (no profile — those TCC classes aren't entitlement-backed).

**Shared machinery**: the wrapping lives in the tap composite action `yasyf/homebrew-tap/.github/actions/wrap-daemon-bundle@v1` (v1.2.1) — reused by any tap-shipped daemon. GOTCHA baked into v1.2.1: the profile-authorization assertion must accept the `TEAMID.*` wildcard, not exact-match the specific group (the v1.2.0 exact-match `grep -qxF` failed the first cc-pool release; same fix in cc-pool release.yml).

**Still pending**: the definitive live proof (two consecutive upgrades, zero prompts on the second) runs via cc-notes runbook b03f9f95 on both Macs — the VM rehearsal was skipped (host Ghostty Local Network TCC blocked it). The first upgrade onto the fix may show ONE last identity-change prompt (path→bundle); the NEXT upgrade must be silent. See [[fp-backend-rollout]]. Portal artifacts (App IDs, 3 DevID profiles, CI secrets) in cc-notes note eac747e9; mechanics in cc-notes doc f71e9b1.
